body.text: Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators (SARMs) are a class of research compounds that bind to androgen receptors with tissue-selective activity. Unlike non-selective androgens, SARMs are studied for their ability to modulate receptor signalling in skeletal muscle and bone tissue with reduced interaction in other receptor-expressing tissues, making them a subject of significant interest in preclinical pharmacology and endocrinology research.

ResearchChem.uk supplies six HPLC-verified SARMs in 60ml liquid format, each prepared at a defined concentration for accurate dosing in laboratory protocols. Every compound is supplied with a Certificate of Analysis confirming purity, identity, and batch data. Products include MK-677 Ibutamoren, RAD-140 Testolone, YK-11 Myostine, LGD-4033 Ligandrol, MK-2866 Ostarine, and GW-501516 Cardarine.

All SARMs are dispatched from the UK within 2–3 working days. Volume discounts apply at checkout for orders of 3 or more bottles. These compounds are supplied strictly for qualified researchers conducting in-vitro laboratory research. Not for human or veterinary use.
